question: What rejuvenating effect results from six months of sustained practice?
premises: The practice is performed for six months
The practice is sustained and repeated
Even an old person becomes youthful
inference: Six months of sustained practice makes even an old person become youthful.
uncertainties: taruṇā āyate reading and agreement are somewhat unclear in transmission
plain_english: Through six months of sustained practice, even an old person becomes youthful.
